collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VII (121-140, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A friend is telling a villager a funny story that the villager already heard this morning.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) is telling (subject) a funny story about a heron that stole (friend.his/her) lunch. It's a good story. (subject) knows it's a good story, because (friend) told it to (subject.him/her) this morning. (friend) is clearly building up to the best part.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) laughs at the best part, and it's still funny, because (friend) does a very good heron. Later (friend) suddenly stops and says, "Did I already tell you that?" "This morning," says (subject). "Why did you let me tell it again?" "You do a very good heron." (friend) seems satisfied with this.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "You told me this morning," says (subject), gently. (friend) groans and covers (friend.his/her) face. "I'm sorry." "Don't be, it was good. Tell me another one." (friend) thinks hard. (friend.He/She) tells one about a crab. (subject) has heard it before, too, but this time (subject.he/she) doesn't mention it.
